summary: CI objectives in st slo: merge-queue latency, the workspace critical path and flakes

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers, and no stored or wire format: the new rows have the existing SloRow fields.

rules.detail: Claim kinds, rules, permissions and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: slo/targets.toml gains [[duration]] (name, about, percentile, target_ms, path) and [[count]] (name, about, max_per_hour, path) entries for CI series under ci/; st slo, GET /v1/slo and GET /v1/client/slo list four more objectives (merge-latency/p50, merge-latency/p95, ci-critical-path/p95, flakes), each no-data until a later change feeds its series. The request-latency read, its gauges and st doctor are unchanged.

downtime.detail: None. The rows are computed on read from the built-in file.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback drops the four rows; the SLO history skips no-data rows, so it records nothing for them.
